entries.58d22fee895174d0: Companies that order the production of printed materials and websites
entries.aa354000298bc159: The company is engaged in printing business, which accepts orders for printed matter from other companies, and in the construction and operation of websites. Construction and operation of websites are carried out by its subsidiary Dee Walk Creation Co., Ltd. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥496 million.
